meta.title: Add vendors manually from Participants
gaps: Opening Participants from the event setup screen and using its setup-screen search or filter to add the vendor
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Opening Participants from the event setup screen and using its setup-screen search or filter to add the vendor

steps.note: Configure the default auction stage with a template.
Add the required event line item.
Commit the event schedule before publishing.
Add the initial participant required for a publishable event, leaving another vendor to be added manually afterward.
Publish the event so its Participants audience can be modified.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the published event's Participants screen, where manual vendor addition is supported.
Search the product's vendor list and add one vendor not already on the round.
Assert that the manually added vendor is listed as a participant.
Confirm the participant audience increased by exactly one.
